items.title: Controlling Reasoning Effort in LLMs
items.content: How LLMs Learn Low-, Medium-, and High-Effort Reasoning Modes
items.contentSnippet: How LLMs Learn Low-, Medium-, and High-Effort Reasoning Modes

summaries.zh:
文章标题：《控制大型语言模型的推理努力》  
文章内容：  
大型语言模型如何学习低、中、高三种推理努力模式。通过分析模型在不同任务中的推理过程，研究者揭示了其调整推理复杂度的机制，为优化模型效率提供了理论依据。
summaries.en: The article explores how Large Language Models (LLMs) learn to operate in low-, medium-, and high-effort reasoning modes. It examines the mechanisms enabling LLMs to adjust their reasoning complexity based on task requirements, input prompts, and computational constraints. The content likely discusses the factors influencing these modes, such as prompt design and model architecture, and how LLMs optimize reasoning effort for efficiency and accuracy. The focus is on understanding the adaptability of LLMs in managing computational resources during inference.

items.title: Recent Developments in LLM Architectures: KV Sharing, mHC, and Compressed Attention
items.content: From Gemma 4 to DeepSeek V4, How New Open-Weight LLMs Are Reducing Long-Context Costs
items.contentSnippet: From Gemma 4 to DeepSeek V4, How New Open-Weight LLMs Are Reducing Long-Context Costs

summaries.zh: 近期，新型开源大语言模型（LLM）如Gemma 4和DeepSeek V4通过KV共享、mHC（多头稀疏注意力）和压缩注意力等技术，显著降低了长上下文处理的成本。这些架构优化提高了计算效率，减少了资源消耗，使大模型在长文本任务中更具实用性。
summaries.en: Recent open-weight LLMs like Gemma 4 and DeepSeek V4 are reducing long-context costs through innovations in architecture. Key developments include KV (Key-Value) sharing, mHC (multi-head cross-attention), and compressed attention. These techniques optimize memory usage and computational efficiency, enabling better handling of extended contexts. The advancements aim to balance performance and resource consumption in large language models.
